description.value: Maruhachi Gaiden is a ramen restaurant on Vancouver's Main Street, operating under the broader Maruhachi Ra-men Canada brand. Situated along a well-traveled urban cycling corridor in South Vancouver, it serves Japanese noodle dishes and offers online pickup ordering. The 'Gaiden' name suggests it may be a spin-off or sister location within the Maruhachi family of restaurants.
